title: Difficult to assemble
text:
Difficult to assemble. Pros: wood is finished; economical; perfect height; the foot rest is at the right spot (I am 5' tall); fits under the overhang of the island;
Cons: screws are too large for the pre drilled sockets. I went to Home Depot and got the right size hardware because these are large screws and are not tapered; the Alan wrench that they provide does not really fit; it is a large package so returning it is not easy; overall, assembly is very difficult, unless you are a carpenter.
